invented.quote: Each book still takes me about four months of full-time work.
invented.why: The brief says each book takes about 4 months, not that it is four months of full-time work.

invented.quote: Last year another publisher paid me $12,500 for a 32-page book of the same scope.
invented.why: The brief says the other book was of the same length (32 pages), not that it was of the same scope (such as having the same number of full spreads).
